DATASET OVERVIEW

MULTIMODAL DATA

SCOPE & PURPOSE

The training task.

  • MULTI-STEP REASONING
  • DOMAIN EXPERTS
  • ADVERSARIAL SAMPLES

Collects problems requiring multi-step reasoning (causal judgment, logic puzzles); experts decompose them into minimal reasoning units, build reasoning-flow diagrams, design adversarial samples to catch logical traps, and produce multiple solution versions.

DATA PRODUCTION & CONSTRUCTION

METHOD & WORKFLOW
  1. 01COLLECT

    Multi-step problems

    Collect problems requiring multi-step reasoning, including causal judgment and logic puzzles.

  2. 02DECOMPOSE

    Minimal reasoning units

    Experts decompose problems into minimal reasoning units.

  3. 03MAP

    Reasoning-flow diagrams

    Build diagrams that make the structure of the reasoning explicit.

  4. 04CHALLENGE

    Adversarial samples

    Design samples to catch logical traps and produce multiple solution versions.
